chunks.text:
[Intro]
Worried and uneasy: a nervous ticking pulse and hesitant plucks,
like someone patting their pockets and realising something is gone.

[Worry grows]
The ticking speeds up, a low pulse joins underneath,
more anxious plucks stacking up as more people lose things.

[Overwhelm]
Panic and overwhelm: everything speeds up and piles on,
rising tension, louder and more cluttered, rushing toward one moment.

[Stop and resolution]
Sudden dead stop: one and a half seconds of complete silence.
Then a warm, bright, satisfying resolution: a major chord lands,
a confident uplifting groove, ending on one clean satisfying final hit.
